memories.memory: My income from painting commissions varies widely, but last year I earned roughly €38,000 before taxes and had to set aside money for studio rent and materials.
In 2022, I took out a €14,500 loan to renovate my studio, and I am still paying €320 a month on it.
A gallery in Valencia agreed to pay me a €6,000 advance for a series of twelve paintings, but the final payment has been delayed for nearly four months.
I keep about €21,000 in a savings account for retirement, although I sometimes use part of it to travel to exhibitions or enter masters swimming competitions.
I paid €2,750 in unexpected tax arrears last spring after an accountant found that several freelance art payments had been reported incorrectly.
My monthly pension is approximately €1,480, so I continue accepting portrait commissions to cover the cost of maintaining my apartment and workshop.
I lent a former studio assistant €1,200 in January to replace damaged equipment, with an agreement that he would repay me in six installments.
